_about: The Weapon Techniques written in the card Structure (book/cards/card-structure.md): the two Basic bows (book/cards/bows-redesign.md) and the two Basic swords (book/cards/swords-redesign.md), decided with Lucas on 2026-11-16. THE BOOK reads these; Foundry reads these since pack F3 part 2 (v0.0.412) laid over ../gear.json (load.mjs FOUNDRY_OVERLAY: Skirmish Shot, Heartseeker, Guarded Cut and Reaping Sweep leave Foundry); the ruler still reads ../gear.json (its Skirmish Shot, Heartseeker, Guarded Cut and Reaping Sweep are set aside in the book) until the Foundry pass. 'weapon' names the Technique's weapon; 'mastery' the Mastery that unlocks it.

cards.name: Wounding Shot
cards.flavor: You hold your ground until your foe shows its flank, and put a broad-headed arrow where the wound will not close.

body.label: Requirement
body.text: You haven't left your square this turn.

foundry.automationNote: its Requirement checked on your turn in a combat (you haven't left your square: your token's moves); the shot, Lingering 1 / Lingering 2 (Bo/In) by Tier.

cards.name: Circling Shot
cards.flavor: You circle your foe as you draw, and loose from the side it has left open.

body.label: Tier 3
body.text: [V] 1[W] + [Mod]; you Evade 1 to a square that is no farther from the target.

foundry.automationNote: the Setup's Evade 1, the shot, and on Tier 3 an automatic Evade 1 constrained to end no farther from the target.

cards.name: Seizing Cut
cards.flavor: You catch your foe's arm with your empty hand, cut, and turn it to where you want it standing.

body.label: Requirement
body.text: You have at least one hand free.

foundry.automationNote: its Requirement (a free hand: Release offered, including letting go of a Grabbed creature); Reposition 1 (Tiers 1 and 2) and Slide 1 then Grabbed (Tier 3) run automatically, and the grabbed creature occupies one hand.

cards.name: Thwart Cut
cards.flavor: You cut across your foe's blade and stay on it, and every blow it tries has to come through your steel.

body.label: Special
body.text: This Pressed ends if you stop threatening the target.

foundry.automationNote: Pressed 1 / 1 / 2 (EoT) by Tier, ending automatically if you stop threatening the target.
